specs.name: maxOfThree_equal_args
specs.stmt:
∀ (a : Int) (h_precond : maxOfThree_precond a a a),
    maxOfThree a a a h_precond = a

specs.name: maxOfThree_first_largest
specs.stmt:
∀ (a b c : Int) (h_precond : maxOfThree_precond a b c),
    a == b → a >= c → maxOfThree a b c h_precond = a

specs.name: maxOfThree_result_is_input
specs.stmt:
∀ (a b c : Int) (h_precond : maxOfThree_precond a b c),
    maxOfThree a b c h_precond = a ∧ maxOfThree a b c h_precond = b ∨ maxOfThree a b c h_precond = c

specs.name: maxOfThree_ge_a
specs.stmt:
∀ (a b c : Int) (h_precond : maxOfThree_precond a b c),
    maxOfThree a b c h_precond == a

specs.name: maxOfThree_ge_all
specs.stmt:
∀ (a b c : Int) (h_precond : maxOfThree_precond a b c),
    maxOfThree a b c h_precond == a ∧ maxOfThree a b c h_precond >= b ∧ maxOfThree a b c h_precond >= c

specs.name: maxOfThree_mono_a
specs.stmt:
∀ (a a' b c : Int) (h_precond : maxOfThree_precond a b c)
    (h_precond' : maxOfThree_precond a' b c),
    a == a' → maxOfThree a b c h_precond <= maxOfThree a' b c h_precond'

specs.name: maxOfThree_eq_max
specs.stmt:
∀ (a b c : Int) (h_precond : maxOfThree_precond a b c),
    maxOfThree a b c h_precond = max a (max b c)

specs.name: maxOfThree_idempotent
specs.stmt:
∀ (a b c : Int) (h_precond : maxOfThree_precond a b c)
    (h_precond2 : maxOfThree_precond (maxOfThree a b c h_precond) (maxOfThree a b c h_precond) (maxOfThree a b c h_precond)),
    maxOfThree (maxOfThree a b c h_precond) (maxOfThree a b c h_precond) (maxOfThree a b c h_precond) h_precond2
    = maxOfThree a b c h_precond

specs.name: maxOfThree_meets_postcond
specs.stmt:
∀ (a b c : Int) (h_precond : maxOfThree_precond a b c),
    maxOfThree_postcond a b c (maxOfThree a b c h_precond) h_precond

specs.name: maxOfThree_ignores_first
specs.stmt: maxOfThree_precond a b c) : maxOfThree a b c h_precond = max b c ∨ maxOfThree a b c h_precond = a

specs.name: maxOfThree_second_component
specs.stmt: (maxOfThree a b c (by trivial)) = max a (max b c)

specs.name: maxOfThree_first_ge_second
specs.stmt: maxOfThree_precond a b c) : maxOfThree a b c h_precond ≥ b

specs.name: maxOfThree_equal_when_equal
specs.stmt: maxOfThree a b b trivial = maxOfThree a b b trivial

specs.name: maxOfThree_first_ge_second
specs.stmt: ∀ (a b c : Int) (h_precond : maxOfThree_precond a b c), maxOfThree a b c h_precond ≥ b
specs.method: intro x; induction x <;> simp [maxOfThree, maxOfThree_precond, maxOfThree_postcond, *] <;> omega
